rules.body: When a subscription can begin decoding before its listener is removed, distinguish listener reception from permission to publish the decoded value. Bind publication to the panel visit that admitted the event; after a switch, hide, or synchronous reentry retires that visit, settlement from it must not update the current panel. Preserve delivery for the current visit, including a later visit using the same channel. Verify by delaying decode across close, switch, and same-channel reopening: the retired visit produces no publication, while the active visit still receives its bootstrap and later update.

limitations: AI evidence review not performed; pending human content review.
